# browser-fs-access (vendored dist)

Restored 2026-10-12 (board: Phase-1 battery, collab Q-matrix M5 row).

`svgedit` 3.4.11's vendored build (`extensions/ext-opensave/ext-opensave.js`)
imports `../node_modules/browser-fs-access/dist/index.modern.js`
(`fileOpen`/`fileSave`). When the svgedit static tree was first committed,
the repo `.gitignore` rule `node_modules/` silently excluded this directory,
so the file was absent from the repo AND every image built from it — the
browser failed the dynamic import ("Extension failed to load: ext-opensave").

Pinned to the exact version svgedit 3.4.11 declares
(`"browser-fs-access": "0.38.0"`, its package.json; Apache-2.0, LICENSE kept
alongside). Source: `npm pack browser-fs-access@0.38.0`.
